title: Oral Glucose Tolerance Test in Mouse
author: Nancy Smith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ujjeukn
materials: STELLUX Chemi Rodent Insulin ELISA kit
Return food and environmental enrichments to cages.

steps.title: Fast the mice
steps.instruction: Fast mice for 4-6 hours starting around 9am.

substeps.instruction: Transfer mice to a clean cage with a wire top.
Provide water bottles during the fasting period.
If using High Fat diet (HFD), save food to return at the end of the OGTT.
Mark tails with a sharpie for identification.

steps.title: Calculate glucose dose
steps.instruction: Weigh each mouse and calculate the bolus dose of sterile glucose (50% dextrose) solution.

substeps.instruction: For standard dose (1g/kg): Weight of mouse (g) x 2 = ul of solution.
For HFD (4 weeks or more) dose (0.5g/kg): Weight of mouse (g) x 1 = ul of solution.

steps.title: Prepare glucose syringes
steps.instruction: Prepare 1cc syringes with 18G oral gavage needles.

substeps.instruction: Load syringes with the calculated glucose doses.
Position syringes in front of the home cage.

steps.title: Measure baseline blood glucose
steps.instruction: Measure time 'zero' blood glucose levels before glucose delivery.

substeps.instruction: Restrain the mouse and clean the tail with 70% ethanol/gauze.
Extract a small amount of blood from the tail vein onto One Touch Ultra blood glucose strips using the One Touch Ultra 2 monitoring system.
Optional: Collect blood into microvette tubes by tapping the tube until all blood is collected; place on ice for plasma collection.

steps.title: Administer glucose bolus
steps.instruction: Administer the calculated dose of sterile glucose (50% dextrose) solution via oral gavage.

substeps.instruction: Restrain the mouse securely but avoid an excessively tight grip to prevent panic.
Ensure the mouse cannot bite or move its head.
Use gravity to move the cannula down the esophagus, rotating slightly as it passes the epiglottis.
Confirm the mouse swallows the cannula and inject the fluid slowly.
Gently remove the cannula and return the animal to its cage.

steps.title: Monitor blood glucose levels
steps.instruction: Test and record blood glucose levels at 15, 30, 60, 90, and 120 minutes after delivery.

substeps.instruction: Record values and animal condition on the Glucose Tolerance Test record sheet.
Extract blood from the tail vein at 15, 30, 60, and 120 minutes for further analysis.
Skip blood collection at 90 minutes to avoid exceeding 0.007 ml blood/g body weight.

steps.title: Process blood for plasma
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collected blood samples to isolate plasma.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes in a pre-chilled centrifuge for 2 mins at 2000 rpm at 4°C.
Remove the capillary-lid and dispose of it in a biohazard bin.
Place the base lid and seal the microvette (click position).
Centrifuge again at 4°C for 10 mins at 10,000 rpm.

steps.title: Store and assay plasma
steps.instruction: Isolate and store plasma for insulin assay.

substeps.instruction: Use a pipette to transfer the plasma (top transparent layer) to a clean, labeled tube.
Store plasma samples at -20°C until assay.
Assay for insulin plasma using a STELLUX Chemi Rodent Insulin ELISA kit by ALPCO.
